name: watch.region
description: Stream image frames of a screen region. Returns a subscription_id; the agent emits EVENT frames carrying image bytes per `interval_ms` (or only when the region changes if `until_change: true`).

region.description: Screen sub-rectangle to capture in virtual-screen coordinates.

interval_ms.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds. Lower values increase CPU + bandwidth cost. Default 250 ms (4 FPS).

until_change.description: If true, emit only when the region's pixels differ from the last sample, then auto-cancel. Useful for `wait until something changes` patterns.

subscription_id.description: Subscription identifier in `sub:N` form. Use with watch.cancel to end the stream.

x-event-schema.description: EVENT frames emitted by this subscription carry image bytes (base64-encoded) of the region per sampling interval. Format follows `system.info.capabilities.image_formats`.

timestamp_unix_ms.description: Capture timestamp as Unix epoch milliseconds.

x-implementations.name: screen_capture_loop
x-implementations.description: Reuses screen.capture's implementation chain (WGC / GDI BitBlt) on a timer thread. `until_change` adds a cheap pixel-hash compare against the previous frame.

windows-modern.description: WGC capture loop on a timer thread; emits EVENT frames per interval. WebP encoding (default) saves ~70% bandwidth vs PNG. `until_change` uses a quick CRC64 compare to skip unchanged frames.

windows-classic.description: GDI BitBlt loop. BMP-only on classic (PNG with GDI+ runtime if probed). Higher per-frame cost than modern; lower interval values may saturate CPU.
